newsitem.title: USA: P-Com unit to buy Control Resources.
newsitem.headline: P-Com unit to buy Control Resources.

text.p: P-Com Inc said one of its subsidiaries agreed to buy Control Resources Corp, in a stock-for-stock merger.
Conrol Resouces, based in Fair Lawn, New Jersey, manufactures products used by the communications industry to connect end user sites to a range of communications services.

"This acquisition is expected to strengthen P-Com's equipment offerings to network service providers by allowing us to deliver more functionality with our next generation radios," George Roberts, chairman and chief executive officer of P-Com, said in a statement. "It will also allow P-Com to broaden our customer base to include organizations that depend exclusively on wireline access technology."
